import re, json, hashlib

def extract_query(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        txt = f.read()
    m = re.search(r'## Exact query\n\n```text\n(.*?)\n```', txt, re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def extract_raw(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        txt = f.read()
    m = re.search(r'## Raw answer \(verbatim\)\n\nThe following is the exact UTF-8 HTTP response body returned by Khoj:\n\n~~~~json\n(.*?)\n~~~~\n', txt, re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

for name, qf in [('q3-supersession.md','q3.txt'), ('q4-relationship.md','q4.txt')]:
    q = open(f'04-evaluation/queries/{qf}').read().strip()
    eq = extract_query(f'04-evaluation/results/{name}')
    raw = extract_raw(f'04-evaluation/results/{name}')
    print(f"== {name} ==")
    print(f"  query file bytes: {len(q)}; exact-query section matches file: {eq == q!r}")
    if raw is None:
        print("  raw answer: NOT FOUND")
        continue
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
        print(f"  raw answer parses as JSON: True, {len(data)} results")
        for i, r in enumerate(data, 1):
            print(f"    result {i}: entry length={len(r['entry'])}, file={r['additional']['file']}, score={r['score']:.4f}")

import re, json

def extract_raw(path):
    txt = open(path).read()
    m = re.search(r'## Raw answer \(verbatim\)\n\nThe following is the exact UTF-8 HTTP response body returned by Khoj:\n\n~~~~json\n(.*?)\n~~~~\n', txt, re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def extract_evidence_entries(path):
    txt = open(path).read()
    # sections: '### Result N — X\n\n...\n\nVerbatim `entry`:\n\n~~~~text\n(.*?)\n~~~~'
    blocks = re.findall(r'Verbatim `entry`:\n\n~~~~text\n(.*?)\n~~~~', txt, re.S)
    return blocks

for name in ['q3-supersession.md', 'q4-relationship.md']:
    path = f'04-evaluation/results/{name}'
    raw = extract_raw(path)
    data = json.loads(raw)
    raw_entries = [r['entry'] for r in data]
    ev_blocks = extract_evidence_entries(path)
    print(f"== {name} ==")
    print(f"  raw answer results: {len(data)}; evidence passage blocks: {len(ev_blocks)}")
    ok = True
    for i, (re_, ev) in enumerate(zip(raw_entries, ev_blocks), 1):
        match = re_ == ev
        ok &= match
        print(f"  result {i}: verbatim match = {match}")
    print(f"  ALL MATCH: {ok}")
EOF
